principle: No duplicate durability engine: every production Graph lifecycle boundary maps to an EXISTING STACK_A primitive where one exists. New code wires, never re-implements (checkpoint store, lease/permit, journal store, fingerprints stay sealed/reused).
productionGraphPath: runSubagentGraph (src/subagent/subagent-graph-runner.mjs — PRODUCTION Graph entry, durable by default) -> runDurableGraph (src/v2/durable-graph.mjs) -> runColimaGraph (src/runtime/colima-graph-runner.mjs) -> runExecutionOrchestrator (src/v2/execution-orchestrator.mjs) -> runDecompositionGraph (src/v2/runner.mjs, sealed) -> runLifecycle (src/lifecycle-runner.mjs)

mapping.productionLifecycle: graph accepted (IR validated, DAG frozen, phase set frozen)
mapping.stackAPrimitive: DAG_ACCEPTED journal event + checkpoint; buildDagFingerprint/buildIrSha256; phase_states frozen (already in runDurableAutoLoop)
mapping.de2Action: DurableGraphRun journals DAG_ACCEPTED + checkpoints after IR freeze; state machine reuse
wire onPhaseStart hook in production path (currently only colima worktree prep)

mapping.stackAPrimitive: PHASE_STARTED journal event + checkpoint with writer_phase_active / writer_lease_holder (buildOrchestratorHooks.onPhaseStart)
SYSTEM_DELTA_READY journal + reviewer-system-delta artifacts + checkpoint (C4S onSystemDeltaReady)
PHASE_REPAIR_REQUESTED journal + phase_attempts in checkpoint (recordRetry D4)
mapping.de2Action: wire lifecycle.onRepairRequested; repair budget must survive restart (Stage 12)

mapping.stackAPrimitive: PHASE_PASSED/PHASE_HELD/PHASE_FAILED journal + phase result artifact + checkpoint via runner onCheckpoint view diff (_onRunnerView)
mapping.de2Action: wire runner.onCheckpoint; F2/F3: seed _lastRunnerStatuses from checkpoint on resume to avoid re-terminalizing already-passed phases
Stage 9: persist worktree identity + pre/post tree identity in checkpoint; classify RESTORABLE/RECONSTRUCTABLE/ALREADY_APPLIED/CONFLICTED/INVALID
Stage 7/8: side-effect identity + worktree inspection before retry; effectively-once within governed writer contract; commit-token pattern (DE-1R S4 reference)

mapping.stackAPrimitive: resumeAutoLoop: verifyJournal + findJournalEventByHead + classifyResumeCapability + fingerprint validation + initialState (statuses) -> runDecompositionGraph initialState
mapping.de2Action: F1: semantic post-head event classification; production path resume via initialState pass-through in runColimaGraph
Stage 13: crash-matrix around write-back; recovery provenance must not break idempotency
Stage 14/15: D7 recovery provenance (executionAttempt/recoveryGeneration/replayOf/recovered/duplicateSuppressed); no double counting
closeout must reflect recovery provenance; bundle binds final source

existingPrimitivesReused: RunEvidenceStore (src/evidence/run-evidence-store.mjs): journal + artifacts + secret-scanned write path
sealed C2D checkpoint-store (src/c2d/checkpoint-store.mjs): checksum + CAS revision + structured lock + write permit

newCodeBoundaries.src/v2/durable-graph.mjs: DurableGraphRun + runDurableGraph + resumeDurableGraph — wires existing primitives behind runColimaGraph; the ONLY new durable state machine
newCodeBoundaries.src/runtime/colima-graph-runner.mjs: surgical: add initialState pass-through + durable hooks wiring (no scheduler/topology change)
newCodeBoundaries.checkpoint-bridge/durable-execution: F1 semantic post-head classification (shared by both resume paths)
newCodeBoundaries.telemetry: D7 recovery provenance fields (minimal, COST-1 compatible)
newCodeBoundaries.src/subagent/subagent-graph-runner.mjs: REPAIR: the production Graph entry — durable by default（runDurableGraph）; sub-agent hooks/adapters extracted into shared factories used by both the durable and raw paths

noParallelEngine: No second journal/checkpoint/lease authority is introduced; the C2D store and RunEvidenceStore remain the single writers.

repairAddendum.productionWiring: every card closeout script invokes runSubagentGraph; it now routes through runDurableGraph BY DEFAULT（durable: true）; durableExecutionIdFor maps logical run ids to C2D-minted ids deterministically（stable across crash + resume）; result keeps the caller's logical executionId + exposes durableExecutionId + recovery/evidence provenance. durable:false is the documented TEST-ONLY escape hatch; a regression guard in test/v2/test-durable-graph.mjs asserts no production script disables it.
repairAddendum.forwardingAndComposition: runDurableGraph/resumeDurableGraph forward profile + executorAdapterFactory/reviewerAdapterFactory + closeout DI to runColimaGraph; DurableGraphRun.buildGraphHooks composes caller onPhaseStart/onPhaseTerminal/lifecycle hooks（sub-agent /results persistence + reviewResult attach survive inside the durable layer）.
repairAddendum.checkpointSerialization: per-run chain serializes checkpoint publication — fast phases can no longer CAS-collide（CHECKPOINT_STALE_REVISION）between runner-view and lifecycle checkpoints.
repairAddendum.finalSourceBinding: implementationDigest over the final production source + focused tests; reviewer identity = sha256({graphRunId, reviewOutcomes, implementationDigest}); graph-closeout evidence carries the same reviewBinding block.
